featured_reviews.name: Fork & Frames
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited Vasu’s Lakshmi Balaji Fast Food Center on SV Road after hearing about it from a lot of our friends and relatives. Almost everyone we knew had recommended this place saying the food here is really good. We had also once tried a sandwich from here earlier, and that had been genuinely tasty, so we were quite excited to try more items from their menu this time.

We visited on a Thursday evening and ordered a Gini Dosa and a Masala Dosa for takeaway. One thing I really liked was that the dosas were made fresh right in front of us, which instantly gave a very nice and hygienic feeling. The preparation took around 15 minutes, and the staff packed everything properly for us to take home.

By the time we reached home, around 15–20 minutes later, the dosas were still pretty hot, which was honestly impressive. Taste-wise, everything was good. I had specifically requested the food to be non-spicy, and they prepared it accordingly, which I really appreciated. They also gave sambar and chutney along with the order, and when I requested their sandwich chutney separately, they were kind enough to provide that too.

Coming to the dosas, the Gini Dosa was good, though I personally felt it leaned slightly towards the sweeter side compared to versions I’ve had at other places. I understand that I had requested non-spicy food, but non-spicy doesn’t necessarily mean sweet, so I think maybe the base or flavour here itself is slightly sweet by default. That was honestly the only thing I noticed. The Masala Dosa tasted nice too, but we felt the potato filling inside was a little less, which made it slightly less filling.

Overall, the food quality, freshness, and service were really good. Just felt the portions could be slightly more filling for two people. They have two outlets on the two sides of the road so on left side as well as on the right side - It’s the same branch
Just mentioning as it gets confusing
One side they have a sitting restaurant and dosas prepared and on the other side they have sandwiches..
Definitely still a must-visit place if you enjoy good Sandwiches or South Indian fast food in Goregaon! 🤤

featured_reviews.name: Naresh Shirodkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tucked into the bustling lanes of Goregaon, Kashi Samosa Bhandar is the kind of place that reminds you why street food in Mumbai is less about trends and more about timeless flavour. No frills, no distractions, just the unmistakable aroma of fresh piping hot oil, crackling kadhai, and snacks that hit every nostalgic note perfectly.
The samosas here are the undisputed superheroes, golden, crisp shells that shatter delicately to reveal a perfectly spiced potato filling. What truly sets them apart is their slow cooking process, fried patiently to achieve that deep, even crispness without excess oil. The result is a samosa that’s light, flavourful, and incredibly satisfying. Pair it with their chutneys and you get that classic sweet spicy tangy harmony that makes you instinctively reach for another.
The vada holds its own beautifully alongside, soft, fluffy on the inside with a perfectly crisp exterior, delivering that comforting, homely flavour of a well made batata vada. Add their dry garlic chutney or tuck it into pav, and it easily competes with some of the city’s most loved vada pav spots.
What truly elevates Kashi Samosa Bhandar is consistency. This isn’t a one time good experience, it’s a place locals trust for that same taste, day after day. Quick service, high turnover, and always fresh batches mean you’re rarely waiting too long, but always getting something hot and just made.

Recommendations:
Don’t miss their classic samosa fresh out of the kadhai
Order a vada pav with extra chutney for the full experience
Best enjoyed standing there, while it’s still piping hot
In a city constantly chasing the new, Kashi Samosa Bhandar stands its ground with simplicity, quality, and flavour that speaks for itself. A true Goregaon gem that proves great food doesn’t need a fancy address, just a loyal following and a perfect recipe.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely pathetic service at Bombay High Street, Food Court, Oberoi Mall (Goregaon East).
This is not the first time, but today’s experience was beyond disappointing. We ordered a sizzler at around 7:02 PM and waited for almost an hour, only to realize the staff had either forgotten to inform the kitchen or completely overlooked the order while taking multiple orders together.

What was even more frustrating was that both I and my friend had to repeatedly go and check on the order—6 times by me and 3 times by my friend—and every single time, the only response we got was “5 more minutes.” After waiting for nearly an hour with no proper update or accountability, we finally lost our patience, asked for a refund, and left.
The staff seems either severely understaffed or simply too slow and careless. They appear interested only in taking orders, but when it comes to actual service and delivery, they completely fail. This has been an ongoing issue every time we’ve visited.

Management seriously needs to pull up their socks—either improve staff efficiency, hire better people, or shut the shop if they cannot manage basic customer service. Customers should not have to chase their own orders multiple times after paying.

Very disappointing experience.
